Descriptions.Weapon Runes:
Any weapon can be inscribed with 1 rune. A rune is destroyed when used to inscribe a weapon, and inscribing a rune onto a weapon replaces the previous rune (if there was any).
Standard runes (like the ones below) can be purchased from most regular stores.
Descriptions.One-Handed Melee: Any Hero can freely use any One-Handed Weapon, as long as the Stat requirements are met. Attacks with One-Handed Weapons only use 1 Action Point, so you can make 3 attacks on your turn, even with the same weapon!
Descriptions.Two-Handed Melee: Any Hero can freely use any Two-Handed Weapon, as long as the Stat requirements are met. Attacks with Two-Handed Weapons use 2 Action Points. If you remain with 1 Action Point unspent, you can do an Improvised Attack, which deals 1d4 + Might Damage at 1 meter Range (or 2 + Instinct at longer ranges).
Descriptions.One-Handed Ranged: Any Hero can freely use One-Handed Weapon, as long as the Stat requirements are met. Attacks with One-Handed Weapons only use 1 Action Point, so you can make 3 attacks on your turn, even with the same weapon!
Descriptions.Two-Handed Ranged: Any Hero can freely use any Two-Handed Weapon, as long as the Stat requirements are met. Attacks with Two-Handed Weapons use 2 Action Points. If you remain with 1 Action Point unspent, you can do an Improvised Attack, which deals 2 + Instinct Damage at 2-5 meters Range.

Cleaver.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll maximum on d6, add another 1d6 Damage, and you take 50% of all the attack's Damage.

Club.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll minimum on d8, Single-Stun the target.
Club.MagicAlternatives: Branch, Rootclub, Femur, Antler, Carrot, Skillet, Idol

Dagger.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll 3 or more, add another 1d6 Damage.
Dagger.Alternatives: Kunai, Kris, Sai, Tanto, Pugio, Rondel

Flail.Notes: Does not scale with any Stat.
Flail.Alternatives: Combat Chains, Kusarigama, Lucerne, Lantern, Anchor

Hand Axe.Combo: Heal for an amount equal to your Presence.
Hand Axe.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll maximum on d12, apply a ~Combo~.

Hand Hammer.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll maximum on d10, apply a ~Combo~.
Hand Hammer.Notes: Does not scale with any Stat.

Mace.Alternatives: Light Morningstar, Pernach, Cudgel, Bludgeon, Truncheon

Punch.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll maximum on d4, also add your other Stat to the Damage.
Punch.Notes:
If your Stats aren't high enough, your punches count as improvised attacks (see Improvised Attack at Default Moves).
On a Critical Strike, if you used Might, you also add Instinct to the roll (or vice-versa, if you used Instinct, you also add Might).
If you used another Stat (certain weird Abilities do this), you add either Might or Instinct, of choice.

Rapier.Effect: {CriticalStrike} If you rolled all equals on the d4's, and wield no other weapon or shield, apply a ~Combo~, then make a free Move Act.

Scimitar.Special: You are more appreciated if you pronounce it as 'Skimitar'
Scimitar.EffectGreen: Your next ranged weapon attack applies a ~Combo~.

Shortsword.EffectGreen: If you roll less than 3 on d6, it counts as a 3.
Shortsword.Alternatives: Falchion, Sabre, Scimitar, Arming Sword, Sabre, Shamshir
Shortsword.MagicAlternatives: Edge, Gladius, Sidearm, Spathion, Blade, Steel, Soulblade

Sickle.Notes: The price is for a battle sickle. A normal peasant's sickle would be half the price, dealing 1 less damage.
Sickle.MagicAlternatives: Hook, Reaphook, Reaper, Hookblade, Harvester, Jawbone, Thornhook, Sica

Whip.Combo: The attack has 6 meters range and ignores Cover.
Whip.MagicAlternatives: Scourge, Flogger, Cord, Tail, Vinelash, Tentacle, Spinewhip

Battle Axe.Combo: Heal for the lower die rolled for each Combo on the target.

Greatclub.MagicAlternatives: Log, Totem, Trunk, Bonecrusher, Skullbreaker, Column, Tree, Greathorn, Boulder, Giantbone, Chandelier, Statue, Anvil, Millstone, Cauldron, Greatrod, Greatstaff, Sausage, Keg, Breaker

Greatsword.EffectGreen: Add all 6's rolled together. They hit another Unit within 2 meters of the target for that amount.
Greatsword.Alternatives: Claymore, Zweihander, Naginata, Broadsword, Bastard Sword
Greatsword.Notes: Hitting another Unit with the d6's is optional.

Halberd.EffectGreen: Has +1d6 Damage against Large or larger enemies.
Halberd.Alternatives: Garden Rake, Glaive, Gleaves, Bardiche, Voulge
Halberd.MagicAlternatives: Poleaxe, Fauchard, Earthsplitter, Warbrand, Fauchard, Woldo

Heavy Mace.Effect: {CriticalStrike} for each rolled 4, Slam the target 1 meters in any direction.

Katana.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll maximum on d6, the Attack gains +1d10 Damage.
Katana.Alternatives: Wakizashi, Longsword, Claymore, Zweihander, Naginata, Broadsword, Bastard Sword, Blade, Edge

Longsword.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll at least 11 on d12, add Damage equal to 10% of the target's current Health!

Pickaxe.EffectGreen: Deals +1d6 Damage against Units wearing a shield or heavy armor (or both).

Quarterstaff.Effect: {CriticalStrike} If you roll 8, the next attack on you deals -50% Damage (if you're still wieleding this weapon).
Quarterstaff.Notes: A Quarterstaff is a wooden weapon masterfully crafted for physical combat, with correct weight and density and properly balanced; it's not a mage's walking stick!
Quarterstaff.MagicAlternatives: Shillelagh, Jo, Bo, Pole, Battlestaff, Warstaff

Scythe.EffectGreen: You can use 2 Action Points to just deal 8 Damage to all Units around you (against their Defense).
Scythe.Notes: The price is for a battle scythe. A normal peasant's scythe would be half the price and can't use the special effect.

Trident.EffectGreen: If you attack from at least 3 meters away from where you started your turn, the attack gains +3 Damage.

Warhammer.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you rolled at least one 8, Single-Stun the target.
Warhammer.Notes: Doesn't do extra Damage if target's Defense would be less than 0.
Warhammer.MagicAlternatives: Maul, Mallet, Martel, Malleus, Sledgehammer, Sledge

Bow.Effect: {CriticalStrike} deal +1d8 extra Damage and applies a ~Combo~ if you roll 8.
Bow.MagicAlternatives: Recurve, String, Yumi, Longbow, Greatbow, Longshot

Heavy Gun.Combo: Deals 50% of the Damage to all other Units within 2 meters of the main target.
Heavy Gun.Downside: After attacking, if you rolled at least one 1, the Heavy Gun jams, and must be reloaded with a 1 Action Point before using it again.
Heavy Gun.Notes: Attacks with this weapon do not add any Stat to the Damage. Using the special effect consumes 2 ammo.
Heavy Gun.MagicAlternatives: Shotgun, Cannon, Rifle, Arquebus, Boomstick, Leadthrower, Roar, Blaster, Sieger

Javelin.Notes: This weapon is baseline made for throwing.

Blowgun.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll 4, apply a ~Combo~. Whatever triggers the Combo deals +1d4 Damage and all the Damage becomes Poison.
Blowgun.Notes: The normal ammunition for this is the Regular Poison Darts (full supply). If your darts are somehow not poisoned, you don't apply the effect.

Handgun.Downside: If you roll at least one 1, the Handgun jams, and must be reloaded with 1 Action Point before using it again.
Handgun.MagicAlternatives: Pistol, Flintlock, Pepperbox, Matchlock, Sidearm, Handcannon, Quickshot
Handgun.Notes: Handgun attacks do not scale with any Stat.

Shuriken.Effect: {CriticalStrike} if you roll 12, the weapon bounces to another chosen Unit within 4 meters and attack it!
Shuriken.Notes: The effect applies even to the bounce attack, so it can keep bouncing as long as you keep rolling 12!
Shuriken.Alternatives: Tomahawk, Boomerang, Kunai, Glaive, Chakram, Kylie

Sling.EffectGreen: Every 3rd Sling attack in Worthy Combat fires another pellet for 1 + Instinct or Presence Damage (not considered a Sling attack).
Sling.Notes: The Sling attack counting carries on from Turn to Turn, but not from Combat to Combat.
